tools.description: Function to lookup a name in the Office of Inspector General (OIG) List of Excluded Individuals & Entitites (LEIE) who are legally excluded from receiving any Federal Medicare or Medicaid funds for services. Search can look for first name, last name, or both. All persons are presumed innocent unless the name and address match the results of a search. For legal chain of custody reasons, this information is inadmissable, but can be verified on the US Health and Human Services Website here: https://exclusions.oig.hhs.gov/

tools.name: Convert_to_Json_text_to_json
tools.description: Convert plain text to structured JSON using Osmosis Structure model. This function takes unstructured text and optionally a JSON schema, then uses the Osmosis Structure model to convert it into well-formatted JSON. The output will follow the provided schema if one is given, otherwise it will create a logical structure based on the input text. Returns: A JSON string containing the structured data, or an error message if something went wrong., , >>> input_text = "The conference will be held on June 10-12, 2024 at the Grand Hotel.", "object", "properties": {"event_start_date": {"type": "string", "format": "date"}}}', >>> result = text_to_json(input_text, schema), >>> print(result), {, "2024-06-10", }
